# arrenstats

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Data analysis package.


## Installation

You can install the development version of arrenstats from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` {r}
#devtools::build_readme()
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("arreen/arrenstats", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```
After installing the package, to use some functions you need keras3 and tensorflow installed. The code below sets up a python evironment used by other functions in the package.

``` {r}
# setup_tf_env()
```

## Workflow
This package outlines the typical data-to-knowledge pipeline where the process naturally progresses by applying stage1_XXX, then advancing to stage2_XXX, and finally generating output via stage3_XXX.

```{r splitting the data}
library(arrenstats)

data <- iris
train_fraction <- 0.65
val_fraction <- 0.25
n <- nrow(data)

train_index <- sample(1:n, round(n*train_fraction))
val_index <- sample((1:n)[-train_index], round(n*val_fraction))

train_data <- data[train_index, ]
val_data <- data[val_index, ]
test_data <- data[-c(train_index, val_index), ]

```

```{r initial options}
y_name <- "Species"
y_type <- "categorical"

```
